newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Jones Apparel estimates up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Jones Apparel estimates up.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Wednesday it raised its estimate for Jones Apparel Group Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.80 a share from $1.75 and for 1998 to $2.15 from $2.05.
-- Rodman had raised the 1997 estimate to $1.75 from $1.70 last month.

-- Rodman said the move followed Jones Apparel's "excellent" results in the fourth quarter of 1996, which came in at $0.30 a share versus $0.22. The results beat Rodman's estimate of $0.26 and First Call's consensus of $0.27.
-- Rodman also sited strong sales of $258 million in the period, which allowed Jones Apparel to break through the $1 billion mark in sales for the full year.
-- Jones Apparel makes women's suits and sportswear.
-- Its shares were unchanged Wednesday at 36-5/8.
